data: NVIDIA delivered a step change in scale and profitability in fiscal 2022. Revenue rose to $26.9 billion from $16.7 billion in fiscal 2021, growth of 61.4%, while gross profit climbed to $17.5 billion from $10.4 billion, leaving fiscal 2022 gross margin at 64.9%. Operating leverage was the standout: operating income more than doubled to $10.0 billion in fiscal 2022 from $4.5 billion in fiscal 2021, producing a fiscal 2022 operating margin of 37.3%. Net income reached $9.8 billion in fiscal 2022 versus $4.3 billion in fiscal 2021, an increase of 125.1%, and diluted EPS rose to $3.85 from $1.73. This expansion came alongside heavier investment, with R&D expense rising to $5.3 billion in fiscal 2022 from $3.9 billion in fiscal 2021. We see rapid top-line growth, wider margins and sustained R&D spending as signs of compounding earnings power.
